profile.name: Abdallah Mohamed
profile.summary: Dedicated and results-driven Flutter developer with a proven track record of designing, implementing, testing, and maintaining complex applications within diverse industries. Over the past 5 years, I have honed my skills in crafting seamless user interfaces and robust functionalities using the Flutter framework. My commitment to staying abreast of the latest technologies, coupled with a passion for creating engaging user experiences, sets me apart in the dynamic field of mobile app development.

projects.name: Alriyadh App
projects.description: The Al Riyadh Waste Management System is a comprehensive platform tailored to enhance waste management operations in Al Riyadh, with features designed for real-time tracking, playback and service charts.

projects.name: Waste Transportation Request
projects.description: Waste Transportation Request is an app with two user types: an admin/advisor who can add requests, and a driver who receives a notification for each request, accepts it, views it on the map, opens the map to navigate to it, and completes the request by attaching an image.
contributions: Notifications in foreground, background and terminated (killed) app states

projects.name: Taher
projects.description: Taher, built with E.VISION, manages waste complaints in Saudi Arabia: an administrator can log in, add a complaint and follow its status.
contributions: Offline mode: an administrator can save a complaint locally and upload it to the server once back online

projects.name: Home Experience
projects.description: A user-friendly app for furniture sales, focusing on seamless e-commerce integration and an intuitive interface.

projects.name: Fix Infinity
projects.description: An app focused on electronic device repairs and product sales.
projects.challenge: Using Pusher to handle real-time chat.

projects.name: Alwsata Real Estate Employees
projects.description: An app that provides accounts for Alwsata Real Estate employees to facilitate their work with the Alwsata system.

projects.name: Alwsata Real Estate Co
projects.description: An app that simplifies the complexities of real estate transactions by offering intuitive financial tools. Users can effortlessly navigate mortgage calculations, explore financing options and deal with their own advisor.

projects.name: Al7feaz
projects.description: A user-friendly mobile app designed for seamless product transactions. With a focus on simplicity, the app allows users to effortlessly sell products, generate invoices for customers and streamline the checkout process. Al7feaz also features convenient QR code scanning, enhancing the efficiency of transactions.

projects.name: DoctorCrypto
projects.description: This app is designed to provide personalized recommendations tailored to your crypto investment goals. Whether you're a seasoned investor or just starting, DoctorCrypto analyzes market trends and your preferences to offer clear, actionable suggestions. Stay informed, make informed decisions.

projects.name: ChkChk
projects.description: ChkChk is a versatile e-commerce app designed for simplicity and practicality. It allows users to effortlessly browse and purchase a variety of products. What sets ChkChk apart is its unique capability to facilitate orders for sending packages to others. The app also features a real-time map, providing users with live updates on the status and location of their orders and deliveries.
projects.challenge: Working with Google Maps and handling real-time location.

projects.name: Messayel
projects.description: Messayel is an app tailored for aspiring knights and horse enthusiasts. This unique platform connects users with trusted trainers and provides a dedicated space for scheduling horse riding lessons. With a built-in store, Messayel also offers a curated selection of knighthood essentials, from rider helmets to specialized tools. It's your gateway to an authentic knighthood experience, bringing together training, equipment and the spirit of chivalry in one convenient app.
projects.challenge: Integrating the Tap payment gateway to handle payments.

projects.name: Bedayat
projects.description: Bedayat is the go-to app for parents with children in kindergarten. Stay connected with your child's day in real time, from their arrival through the kindergarten gate to daily activities like meals. With personalized accounts for each child, Bedayat keeps you informed and engaged, letting you care for your little one with ease. It's your window into your child's daily adventures and a convenient tool for ensuring their well-being at every step.
